requirement.title: Generator and analyzer crash with IndexOutOfRangeException on a closed generic struct from a referenced assembly

acceptanceCriteria.text: A [MessagePackObject] type with a member of a closed generic value type from a referenced assembly builds cleanly and gets a generated resolver.
The other trigger-matrix shapes (non-generic struct, generic or non-generic class, non-generic record struct) keep working as before.
No CS8785 or AD0001 warning is produced for these shapes.

claims.text: The constructor now wraps the caller-supplied diagnostic reporter so that every diagnostic is passed through ReportIfLocatedInCompilation before being reported.
claims.modelNote: Wrapping happens only when reportAnalyzerDiagnostic is non-null.
claims.statusReason: The citation resolves. The claim describes code; no executed check is needed or implied.

claims.text: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation drops a diagnostic unless its location is in source and its syntax tree belongs to the compilation being analyzed, so diagnostics for metadata-only members are not reported.
claims.modelNote: This is the mechanism that avoids reporting against a location that does not exist.
claims.statusReason: The citation resolves. The claim describes code; no executed check is needed or implied.

claims.text: The MemberNeedsKey diagnostic site now uses DeclaringSyntaxReferences.FirstOrDefault()?.GetSyntax().GetLocation() instead of indexing [0], so a member with no source declaration yields a null location rather than throwing.
claims.modelNote: Null location is then filtered out by ReportIfLocatedInCompilation.
claims.statusReason: The citation resolves. The claim describes code; no executed check is needed or implied.

claims.text: The BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull diagnostic site now obtains its location from GetPropertyIdentifierLocation, which returns null when the property has no PropertyDeclarationSyntax in source, instead of casting DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0].
claims.statusReason: The citation resolves. The claim describes code; no executed check is needed or implied.

refusals.question: Should the new README section and doc/analyzers/MsgPack004.md note about referenced-assembly diagnostics be included in this fix?
refusals.whyAiRefused: Documentation scope and wording are product decisions for the owner, not verifiable from the diff.

refusals.question: Is it acceptable that the unkeyed-member test (ClosedGenericStruct_FromMetadataReference_UnkeyedMember) fails under the minimal FirstOrDefault-only fix (CHK4), i.e. that the diagnostic-suppression wrapper is required?
refusals.whyAiRefused: This is a design trade-off about which diagnostics are suppressed for metadata types; the owner must decide the intended behavior.

outOfRequirement.description: Adds a README section 'Generic types from referenced assemblies' (README.md lines 1639-1642).
Adds a 'Types from referenced assemblies' section to doc/analyzers/MsgPack004.md (lines 49-52).
Adds a new GetPropertyIdentifierLocation helper and uses it at the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull site, which is a different diagnostic from the reported crash.
